description: Click (or double-click with dblClick: true) with the virtual mouse (visual cursor). Accepts CSS selector/@ref or direct (x, y) coordinates. Supports inline post-click waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText and includeSnapshot.

clickCount.description: Click count (1 for single click, 2 for double click)

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

dblClick.description: Perform a double-click (dispatches click + dblclick events; default: false)

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after clicking (default: false)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after clicking

via.description: Input backend: synthetic (default), cdp (trusted), auto (cdp with synthetic fallback)

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after clicking

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after clicking

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after clicking (saves a separate wait call)
